name: SD-QA
intro: SD-QA 是基于 TyDi QA 构建的多语言方言语音问答基准，包含 255 名说话者以 24 种语言变体录制的 6.8 万余条问题，覆盖阿拉伯语、孟加拉语、英语、斯瓦希里语和韩语。它联合评估语音识别、段落选择、最小答案抽取及跨方言公平性。
build_method: TyDi QA 原生问题抽样；255 名说话者覆盖 24 种方言录音；ASR 与说话者元数据配对
language: 阿拉伯语, 孟加拉语, 英语, 斯瓦希里语, 韩语
task_type: 语音识别, 段落选择, 最小答案抽取
eval_feature: 跨 24 种方言及说话者群体比较 ASR 与问答稳健性和公平性
scale: 超过 68,000 条语音问题，24 种方言，255 名说话者
build_method_en: Native TyDi QA question sampling; recordings from 255 speakers across 24 varieties; ASR and speaker-metadata pairing
eval_feature_en: ASR and QA robustness and fairness comparisons across 24 dialects and speaker populations
intro_en: SD-QA is a multilingual spoken-dialectal QA benchmark built from TyDi QA, with more than 68,000 questions recorded by 255 speakers across 24 varieties of Arabic, Bengali, English, Kiswahili, and Korean. It jointly evaluates speech recognition, passage selection, minimal-answer extraction, and cross-dialect fairness.
scale_en: More than 68,000 spoken questions, 24 dialects, 255 speakers
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SD-QA arXiv:2109.12072 Sections 2-3 and official ffaisal93/SD-QA data and baseline layout. SD-QA augments TyDi QA with more than 68,000 human-recorded spoken questions in Arabic, Bengali, English, Kiswahili, and Korean, spanning 24 language varieties and 255 speakers. It uses native TyDi QA questions rather than translations, takes the original TyDi QA development set as test, samples development items from training, and removes those items from the text training data; no spoken training set is provided. Recordings, gold and ASR transcripts, speaker metadata, contexts, and answers are packaged by language, dialect, and split. Evaluation covers ASR with word error rate, passage selection and minimal-answer selection with TyDi QA F1, and robustness or fairness comparisons across dialects and speaker populations.
